meta.title: FOIA / Records-Request Templates
meta.description: Static jurisdiction templates for records-request generators. Off-the-shelf boilerplate an operator fills from the backbone; not legal advice. Local-only, no phone-home.
meta.note: Each entry is a jurisdiction-scoped template with placeholders {{...}} filled from data/world_backbone.json at render time.

templates.label: US Federal FOIA request
templates.body: Under the Freedom of Information Act (5 U.S.C. § 552), I request copies of records pertaining to {{topic}} ({{iso3}}). I am a member of the news media/NGO and request a fee waiver. Preferred format: electronic.
templates.disclaimer: Template only — verify against the agency's current FOIA regulations before sending.

templates.label: Brazil LAI request (Lei de Acesso à Informação)
templates.body: Com fundamento na Lei de Acesso à Informação (Lei nº 12.527/2011), solicito acesso aos registros sobre {{topic}} ({{iso3}}). Formato preferido: eletrônico.
templates.disclaimer: Modelo apenas — confira o endereçamento do órgão antes do envio.

templates.label: EU GDPR data-access request
templates.body: Under Article 15 of the GDPR (Regulation 2016/679), I request access to personal data and records held concerning {{topic}} ({{iso3}}).
templates.disclaimer: Template only — national implementations may add requirements.

templates.label: Generic records request (fallback)
templates.body: I respectfully request access to public records pertaining to {{topic}} ({{iso3}}). If fees apply, please notify me before processing. Preferred format: electronic.
templates.disclaimer: Generic fallback — adapt to local public-records law.
